name: Annoyed Picard
look: Captain Jean-Luc Picard, played by Patrick Stewart, stands on the starship bridge in a red and black uniform, mouth open and one hand thrust out palm-up in exasperation. Worf, in a gold uniform with a silver sash, stands in the background.
use: Expresses exasperated disbelief at a baffling decision. The caption asks an incredulous question, often "Why would you..." or "What the hell...", about someone's illogical behavior while Picard gestures in frustration.
slots: top caption: the start of the exasperated question
bottom caption: the baffling thing someone did
examples: Put the empty milk carton back in the fridge?
You have a calendar on your phone
Why are you asking me what day it is?
describe: star trek captain throwing his hand out in frustration
bald captain in a red uniform annoyed and exasperated
patrick stewart arguing with his palm up on the bridge
starship captain asking what the heck with worf behind him
origin: Patrick Stewart as Captain Jean-Luc Picard on the bridge in Star Trek: The Next Generation, with Michael Dorn's Worf behind him.
